title: Music
subtitle: Prompt-to-song studio. Every take lands in the library below.
needsKey: Add a {gateway} gateway key in {settings} to generate music.
describeHint: Say what the song is. The model writes the lyrics.
customHint: Paste your own lyrics. Style and title are yours too.
stylePlaceholder: Style tags, e.g. lo-fi, mellow, rhodes
generatingHint: A song takes a few minutes. Leave this open.
emptyBody: Generate a track to fill this library.
takesNote: One job returns two takes and is billed once. Both are saved.

noModels.title: No music model to pick
noModels.body: This desk was not offered a music model. Music runs on the gateway's Suno relay, which its model list does not advertise — if this persists, refresh the model list in Settings and tell the gateway operator that {gateway} is not serving the relay for this key.

voiceUnavailable.realtimeOnly: This gateway's only text-to-speech model is realtime (WebSocket), which a job route cannot reach. Voice-over turns on by itself once a standard speech model appears in the catalog.
voiceUnavailable.noAudioModels: This gateway serves no text-to-speech model. Voice-over turns on by itself once one appears in the catalog.

outputTextLanguage: Lyrics, title, and any sung or spoken words must be in English unless the prompt already names another language.

estimate.unknown: No list price on file for this model
